criteria.requirement: Repair HookCaller.call_historic to apply specification defaults then shallow-copy the kwargs mapping before recording/executing. Deferred plugin replay observes call-time keys/values even if caller later replaces/clears the outer mapping. Nested mutable objects remain intentionally shared by identity; do not deepcopy user values or callbacks. Preserve custom Mapping input, empty mappings, defaults, result_callback behavior, existing call ordering and nonhistoric hooks.
